## Description

Owner request, 14 Nov 2026: "print the consultation of that day, the patient record and the medicines; and if the doctor gave a lab test, go to the lab with only the lab paper. Same format: clinic name and address at the top, then the items."

Persona and route: The patient record (all tabs) and the consultation · doctor, nurse, receptionist (by role, below).
Today: the investigation slip, referral letter and prescription are server PDFs with logo, signature, SHA-256 and a QR verify link (#1044, ADR-018), recorded in prescribing.PrintedPapers with an audit event. The signed note prints (MDV-P2-049 adds vitals, allergies and diagnoses). The lab slip is reachable only from inside the consultation's Orders panel. There is no record summary paper, no current medicines paper and no single place to print.
Proposed UX behaviour:
- One Print menu in the bottom bar (DESIGN.md Screen layout standard) of the patient record and of a finished visit, listing only the papers that exist for this patient and that this role may print: Visit summary (the day's signed note with vitals, allergies, diagnoses, medicines and tests ordered; one visit), Record summary, Current medicines, Investigation slip (per visit with placed orders; the lab copy, nothing else), Prescription (per authorised Rx). Each opens Print and Download PDF.
- One paper format for every Medvya paper (the existing Rx and slip already follow it; new papers reuse the same QuestPDF header and footer components):
  - Header: clinic logo, clinic name, facility address and phone, clinic registration number; the doctor's name, qualification and licence where the paper is clinical.
  - Patient block: name, age and sex, MRN, date of birth; the allergy in words on every clinical paper (Allergies not recorded when unknown, never blank).
  - Body: the items (the paper's own content), in sections with headings.
  - Footer: issued by and date and time in the facility time zone, Page n of N, the SHA-256 and QR verify link, "Synthetic" watermark outside production.
- Record summary content (default): active problems, allergies, current medicines, last vitals, recent results, immunisations where present, and the last five visits with diagnoses. No free-text note bodies beyond the visit summaries. Unknowns print as Not recorded.
- Current medicines: generic name first, dose, route, frequency, since, prescriber; patient-reported medicines marked as such.
- Every print and download is a server PDF written once to Blob, recorded in PrintedPapers and audited (the access log shows who printed which paper). No PHI in URLs, file names or logs: the file name is the paper kind and date only.
Authorisation (server-side, every endpoint): doctor all papers; nurse visit summary, current medicines and investigation slip; receptionist investigation slip and prescription copy only (no clinical summary). Owner to confirm (see notes).
Components and tokens affected: StickyActionBar with a Print menu (library DropdownMenu); QuestPDF paper header and footer shared by all papers; PaperDocument endpoints in the owning modules.
Front end and back end split: Both. Back end: two new paper kinds (record summary, current medicines) and a visit summary built from MDV-P2-049; endpoints with policies; tests on real PostgreSQL and Azurite. Front end: the Print menu, print preview pages, en/hi/ar keys.
Clinical sign-off: The record summary content and the visit summary layout are reviewed by the pilot doctor before the pilot uses them (MDV-P1-108 session).
Effort and regression risk: M · Medium: new PHI-bearing documents and a new authorisation surface.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Sending papers to the patient app or by WhatsApp (MDV-P2-020 covers the Rx link). (2) Letters and certificates from templates (MDV-P5). (3) Translated paper bodies beyond today's Rx rule.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a patient record with a signed visit, placed orders and an authorised Rx, when a doctor opens Print in the bottom bar, then Visit summary, Record summary, Current medicines, Investigation slip and Prescription are listed and each opens Print and Download PDF
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the investigation slip, when it prints, then it holds the header, the patient block, only the ordered tests and the footer, nothing else from the record
- [ ] **AC3.** Given any Medvya paper, when it renders, then the header shows the clinic logo, name, address, phone and registration number, the patient block shows the allergy in words, and the footer shows issued by, date and time, Page n of N and the QR verify link
- [ ] **AC4.** Given a receptionist, when they call the record summary or visit summary endpoint, then the server refuses with 403, and the Print menu does not list them
- [ ] **AC5.** Given another tenant's patient id, when any paper endpoint is called, then it is refused (EF filter and row-level security)
- [ ] **AC6.** Given a print or download, when the access log is read, then it names who printed which paper and when, and no PHI appears in the URL, file name or logs
- [ ] **AC7.** Given English and Arabic, when the Print menu and preview render, then axe finds no violation and the Arabic paper reads right to left

## Test notes

- Integration (Testcontainers PostgreSQL + Azurite): each paper kind, PrintedPapers row and audit event, 403 per role, cross-tenant refusal (mutation-checked).
- Playwright: J2 step for the Print menu; the lab-only slip; en and ar with axe.

## Notes / open questions

- Owner decision: who may print the record summary (proposed: doctor only) and whether a receptionist may print the investigation slip (proposed: yes, so the patient can take it to the lab).
- Regression risk: medium.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
